decisions.statement: Whether the file at a path is only added to at its end is one question asked here.
A file property says that of every file that property has rather than of one file.
A property naming no file says it of each file the property's section names.
A property naming a file says it of that file beside a page carrying the property.
What a face says over every file property is worked out once for that face.
A face built again works it out again.

definition: whether the file at a path is only ever added to at its end
